description: Two-sided contract for the E2E fake `claude` shim (#666, docs/e2e-testing-concept.md §4.2). The PRODUCER is agent-image/e2e/claude; the CONSUMER is _map_stream_json_line in agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py (the live runtime parser). test_agent_entrypoint.py::FakeClaudeShim runs the shim as a subprocess for each case, feeds its stdout line-by-line through the real parser (threading one usage_sink like the runtime does), and asserts the normalized events equal expectedEvents. If either side changes shape, this fixture must change with it — the shim's stream-json can never silently drift from what the runtime accepts.

expectedEvents.text: Hello from the fake claude shim.

expectedEvents.result: Hello from the fake claude shim.

cases.name: marker echoed back for unambiguous assertion

expectedEvents.text: E2E-ACK:tok-9 Hello from the fake claude shim.

expectedEvents.result: E2E-ACK:tok-9 Hello from the fake claude shim.
